newsitem.title: USA: AST reshuffle continues, 2 execs resigns.
newsitem.headline: AST reshuffle continues, 2 execs resigns.

text.p: AST Research Inc said on Friday that two top-level executives have resigned from the company in a further reshuffling of its upper management ranks.
Michael Willcocks, senior vice president Asia Pacific and Gerald T. Devlin, senior vice president, Americas have resigned to pursue other career opportunities.

"Although stability is an important long-term goal in our return to profitability, changes may inevitably occur," said Y.S. Kim, AST chief executive. "Our strategy is to streamline the decision making process and empower management to respond quickly to fast-changing needs of the technology marketplace.

Assuming responsibility for the Asia Pacific will be Hoon Choo, 50 a member of Samsung Electronics Co Ltd's team that has been working to turnaround AST. Samsung owns about 49.6 percent of the company, including stock options.
Responsibilities for the Americas will be filled on an interim basis by Kim until a permanent executive can be found.
The resignations add to the recent list of executive departures that included Chief Executive Ian Diery in Augus and Chief Financial Officer Joseph Norberg in September.
AST said it created the new job of Senior Vice President, Global Corporate Marketing and Communications.
